q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: WITH CTE AS ( SELECT SALES_ID FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDERS.COM_ID IN (SELECT COMPANY.COM_ID FROM COMPANY LEFT JOIN ORDERS ON COMPANY.COM_ID = ORDERS.COM_ID WHERE NAME = 'RED' ) ) SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON WHERE SALES_ID NOT IN (SELECT SALES_ID FROM CTE)
